# Shisha Lounge Angelo

> Shisha Lounge Angelo is a shisha lounge, shisha bar and hookah lounge in Amsterdam De Pijp (Albert Cuypstraat 158 A, 1073 BK). Guests come for shisha Amsterdam, hookah, chicha, nargile and waterpijp, plus drinks (€4–€20) in an Arabic–Egyptian café atmosphere. Also known as Eetcafe Angelo. Google rating 4.3/5 from 197 reviews.

Last updated: 2026-07-29

## Key facts
- Address: Albert Cuypstraat 158 A, 1073 BK Amsterdam, Netherlands (De Pijp)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +31 6 1473 3574 · https://wa.me/31614733574
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 16:00–01:00 · Friday–Saturday 16:00–03:00
- Metro: Line 52 south from Amsterdam Centraal → De Pijp (3rd stop), ~4 minutes, then a short walk
- Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Jq7MfQ3BEhZ3KkqLA
- Apple Maps: https://maps.apple/p/seDydZDCM0SRny

- Cuisine / vibe: Middle Eastern shisha lounge · hookah bar · Arabic–Egyptian cafe atmosphere
- Coordinates: 52.3556539, 4.894549
- Alternate names: Eetcafe Angelo · Angelo Lounge · Angelo Amsterdam · Angelo Pijp
